decisions.reason: The keyword policy does not change the source or presentation of the testimonial material.
The message reiterates that the entire script must be in Hindi, which is already fully represented by the current Hindi-only language state.
The source changes keyword diversity but does not change the required directness or market alignment of the opening hook.
Requiring additional reference-derived keywords does not change the existing reference-based creative foundation or its relationship to the reference.
The keyword constraint does not modify the independently stated requirement for a viral creative style.
The source does not change the target audience age range or the requirement's Indian-market context.
The source contains no decision about the call-to-action or its integration into the edit.
The source changes script keyword usage but does not alter the campaign's CPL target or conversion-performance priority.
Script keywords and language do not resolve or modify the production-method conflict concerning live-action and AI-generated visuals.
The source does not change lip-sync accuracy or natural facial-expression requirements.
The keyword and Hindi-script instructions do not change responsibility for supplying the script, visuals, or voiceover.
The source does not change the pilot quantity, duration, formats, or conditional follow-on order.
